descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță pentru externalizare și delocalizare și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group , Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting . We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.
 About the role: 
 We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to develop, integrate, deploy and operate cloud-native services supporting connected products and an IoT platform on AWS. The engineer will work as part of an integrated Build & Run team, contributing to feature development, system integration, deployment, testing, troubleshooting and production support.
 A typical day might include the following: 
Develop and maintain cloud-native backend applications and services
Develop REST APIs and system integrations
Implement asynchronous and event-driven workflows
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code
Build and maintain containerised workloads
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
Develop unit and integration tests
Support integration activities with connected systems and devices
Monitor and troubleshoot cloud applications and services
Participate in production incident investigation and resolution
Contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective actions
Support application releases and production deployments
Contribute to platform performance, reliability, security and cost optimisation
Work closely with Senior Cloud Engineers and the Client’s engineering teams in an Agile environment.
 To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills: 
 Cloud & Platform
Strong hands-on experience with AWS
Kubernetes
Docker and containerized applications
Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
CI/CD and deployment automation
Experience with GitHub-based development workflows
Monitoring, logging and troubleshooting of distributed cloud applications
 Software Engineering
Strong backend software development skills
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language suitable for cloud-native backend development
Experience developing REST APIs and microservices
Experience with asynchronous and event-driven architectures
Automated testing and software quality practices
Git-based software development workflows
Solid understanding of software engineering best practices
 Data & Integration
Experience with relational databases and SQL
Experience with PostgreSQL is preferred
Experience with managed database services such as AWS RDS
Experience integrating distributed applications and external systems
Understanding of authentication, certificates and secure service communication
 IoT & Connected Products
Experience with IoT or connected-device platforms
Understanding of device-to-cloud communication
Experience with MQTT is strongly preferred
Experience with AWS IoT services is strongly preferred
Understanding of telemetry, messaging and remote-device interactions
 Operations
Experience supporting production cloud applications
Monitoring and application troubleshooting
Incident investigation and resolution
Root-cause analysis and corrective actions
Release and deployment support
Basic understanding of cloud security and vulnerability management
Performance and reliability troubleshooting
4-7 years of software engineering experience
Proven experience in cloud-native backend development
Experience working in Agile and DevOps engineering teams,
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information you provide is confidential.
